# Predicting a baseball player’s Salary

Using the Hitters data set. Based on Years (the number of years that he has played in the major leagues) and Hits (the number of hits that he made in the previous year). 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
data(Hitters, package = 'ISLR')
salary <- Hitters %>% 
  dplyr::select(Salary, Years, Hits) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(logSalary = log(Salary))
```

The first few rows of the data
```{r}
head(salary)
```

Now split the data into training and test
```{r}
salary_tr <- salary[1:150, ]
salary_te <- salary[-(1:150), ]
```


## Fit a Decision Tree

```{r class.source="bg-danger"}
library(tree)
sal_tree <- tree(logSalary ~ Years + Hits, data = salary_tr)
plot(sal_tree)
text(sal_tree)
```


## Cross-validation to predict the log Salary

```{r class.source="bg-danger"}
set.seed(0)
cv_sal_tree <- cv.tree(sal_tree)

# choose the smallest tree among those with the same cross validation error/deviance
best_size <- with(cv_sal_tree, min(size[dev == min(dev)]))

#The subtree with best_size terminal nodes
sal_tree_final <- prune.tree(sal_tree, best = best_size)

ggplot(data.frame(size = cv_sal_tree$size, mse = cv_sal_tree$dev / 150),
       mapping = aes(x = size, y = mse)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = best_size, col = "red")
```

## Visualizing the pruned regression tree

```{r class.source="bg-danger"}
plot(sal_tree_final)
text(sal_tree_final)
```

## Compute the training and test error
```{r class.source="bg-danger"}
pred_tr <- predict(sal_tree_final, newdata = salary_tr)
pred_te <- predict(sal_tree_final, newdata = salary_te)
mse_tr <- mean((pred_tr - salary_tr$logSalary)^2)
mse_te <- mean((pred_te - salary_te$logSalary)^2)
```
```{r class.source="bg-danger"}
mse_tr
mse_te
```

## Compare with Linear Regression
```{r class.source="bg-danger"}
fit_lm <- lm(logSalary ~ Years + Hits, data = salary_tr)
pred <- predict(fit_lm, newdata = salary_te)
mean((pred - salary_te$logSalary)^2)
```

# Trees for classification: Example for predicting high salary

Create a categorical output variable and split into training and test.
```{r class.source="bg-danger"}
salary <- salary %>%
  mutate(high_salary = as.factor(logSalary > median(logSalary)))
salary_tr <- salary[1:150, ]
salary_te <- salary[-(1:150), ]
```

## Using the entropy to split
```{r class.source="bg-danger"}
sal_tree <- tree(high_salary ~ Years + Hits, data = salary_tr)
set.seed(0)
cv_sal_tree <- cv.tree(sal_tree, method = "misclass")

# choose the smallest tree among those with the same cross validation error
best_size <- with(cv_sal_tree, min(size[dev == min(dev)]))

#The subtree with best_size terminal nodes
sal_tree_final <- prune.tree(sal_tree, best = best_size, method = "misclass")

ggplot(data.frame(size = cv_sal_tree$size, class_err = cv_sal_tree$dev / 150),
       mapping = aes(x = size, y = class_err)) + 
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = best_size, col = "red")
```

## Visualizing the pruned classification tree

```{r class.source="bg-danger"}
plot(sal_tree_final)
text(sal_tree_final)
```

## Compute the training and test classification error
```{r class.source="bg-danger"}
pred_tr <- predict(sal_tree_final, newdata = salary_tr, type = "class")
pred_te <- predict(sal_tree_final, newdata = salary_te, type = "class")
class_err_tr <- mean(pred_tr != salary_tr$high_salary)
class_err_te <- mean(pred_te != salary_te$high_salary)
```
```{r class.source="bg-danger"}
class_err_tr
class_err_te
```

## Using the Gini index to split

```{r class.source="bg-danger"}
sal_tree <- tree(high_salary ~ Years + Hits, data = salary_tr, split = "gini")
set.seed(0)
cv_sal_tree <- cv.tree(sal_tree, method = "misclass")

# choose the smallest tree among those with the same cross validation error
best_size <- with(cv_sal_tree, min(size[dev == min(dev)]))

#The subtree with best_size terminal nodes
sal_tree_final <- prune.tree(sal_tree, best = best_size, method = "misclass")

ggplot(data.frame(size = cv_sal_tree$size, class_err = cv_sal_tree$dev / 150),
       mapping = aes(x = size, y = class_err)) + 
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = best_size, col = "red")
```

## Visualizing the pruned classification tree

```{r class.source="bg-danger"}
plot(sal_tree_final)
text(sal_tree_final)
```


## Compute the training and test classification error
```{r class.source="bg-danger"}
pred_tr <- predict(sal_tree_final, newdata = salary_tr, type = "class")
pred_te <- predict(sal_tree_final, newdata = salary_te, type = "class")
class_err_tr <- mean(pred_tr != salary_tr$high_salary)
class_err_te <- mean(pred_te != salary_te$high_salary)
```
```{r class.source="bg-danger"}
class_err_tr
class_err_te
```
